canonical_project: Niger national Tier III data center, PK5 Niamey
owner: Government of Niger / Ministry of Communication and New Information Technologies; financed by African Development Bank Group
notes: National data center under the Trans-Sahara Optical Fibre Backbone Project. ANP reported on 2025-02-27 that the Tier III national data center was under construction with AfDB support, 13% complete, cost over 9bn CFA, and expected receipt by 2025-09-30. AfDB's 2025-11-21 release lists installation of a Tier III national data centre as a core component and says an 88 km Niamey urban loop will connect administrative sites to the future national data centre. BNEE EIES identifies the project location as PK5, Arrondissement Communal II, Niamey. No MW capacity found.
